highlights.title: Gemini on your Google subscription
highlights.line: Sign in on Google's own page, and Gemini gets its own row in AI Models.

highlights.title: See what your Gemini agents are doing
highlights.line: Gemini agents now show Working, Idle or Needs you, like every other agent.

highlights.title: Remove this computer from Kosmos Plus
highlights.line: Kosmos Plus has a way to take this computer off your account, with a confirm first.

highlights.title: A clearer Tasks page
highlights.line: Every task grouped by where the work is, with the count right in the title.
